popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus names Sthenele daughter of Acastus among the mothers given for Patroclus — the Iolcan princess whose son becomes Achilles' companion after the dice-quarrel at Opus.

popCulture.title: Patroclus
popCulture.description: Patroclus' mother varies by author — Sthenele is one of Apollodorus' options, the Acastid link behind the Iliad's dearest companion.

popCulture.title: Sthenele
popCulture.description: Daughter of Acastus at Iolcus — in one stemma mother of Patroclus, distinct from the Danaid Sthenele.
